title: Cheese and Onion Tart
subtitle: Buttery shortcrust with a rich cheddar and caramelised onion filling
excerpt: A classic tart with a crisp shortcrust pastry shell and a creamy cheddar filling packed with slowly softened onions. It works equally well warm from the oven or at room temperature. Good for a starter, lunch, or a picnic spread.
sourceNotes: Drawn from British and French tart-making traditions. Shortcrust ratios and blind-baking method follow standard pastry technique.

content.text: Brush the blind-baked pastry base with a beaten egg glaze and return it to the oven for 5 minutes before adding the filling. This seals the base and prevents a soggy bottom.

items.prepNote: 1 lightly beaten for glaze, 2 beaten for filling

content.text: Put the flour and cold butter in a food processor. Pulse until the mixture looks like breadcrumbs. Add 2 to 3 tbsp cold water and pulse until the dough just comes together. Wrap and chill for 20 minutes.

Heat a large pan over low heat with a little butter. Add the onions and a pinch of salt. Cook slowly for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft and golden. Remove from the heat and leave to cool.

Heat the oven to 180C. Roll the pastry out on a floured surface and line a 23cm tart tin. Prick the base, line with baking paper, and fill with baking beans. Blind bake for 15 minutes. Remove the beans and paper, brush the base with the egg glaze, and bake for another 5 minutes.
Beat the 2 remaining eggs with the double cream. Stir in most of the cheddar and the thyme leaves. Season well with salt and pepper.

Spread the caramelised onions over the pastry base. Pour the cream mixture over the top. Scatter the remaining cheddar over everything. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes until the filling is just set and lightly golden.

items.cause: Pastry was not chilled before baking.
items.fix: Chill the lined tin for 15 minutes before baking.

items.symptom: Filling is still wobbly after baking.
items.cause: Needs more time in the oven.
items.fix: Bake 5 more minutes and check again.

items.cause: Base was not sealed with egg glaze.
items.fix: Brush with egg glaze and return to oven for 5 minutes.
